name: raisedadead-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by @raisedadead. Personal toolbox: dossier workflow, scratchpad management, and friends.

plugins.name: dossier
plugins.description: Phase-scoped engineering workflow: single-file DOSSIER.md, cross-repo state, drift detection, resumable builds, evidence log. Composes the whetstone plugin at phase gates when installed (doubt, TDD proof, merge-resolve, skill lint) — fully functional without it.

plugins.name: whetstone
plugins.description: Engineering-craft skills that sharpen the edge: red-green TDD, flaky-test audit, pre-decision doubt review, merge-resolve, and skill linting. Each with a deterministic self-verify. Auto-composed by the dossier plugin at its phase gates when both are installed — fully functional standalone.
